scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/verify-build-contract.ts src/glitchtip-smoke-command.ts src/forward-performance-command.ts src/inference-cost-command.ts src/streaming-diagnostics-command.ts src/restate/restate-execution-server.ts src/restate/restate-execution-activate.ts src/restate/restate-research-server.ts src/research-command.ts src/opencode-command.ts src/jev-evaluation-command.ts src/valkey-command.ts --target=node --external tigerbeetle-node --external @platformatic/kafka --entry-naming '[name].js' --outdir=dist
scripts.test:property: bun test src/equity-hours.property.test.ts src/reconciliation.test.ts src/reconciliation/partial-position-cost.test.ts src/execution/order-terms.property.test.ts src/execution/mutation-authority.test.ts src/accounting/cash-settlement.test.ts src/target-planner.test.ts src/cycle/recovery.property.test.ts src/accounting/fee-accrual.test.ts src/jev/acceptance.test.ts src/jev/entry-economics.test.ts src/jev/available-history.property.test.ts src/jev/benchmark-bars.property.test.ts src/jev/signal-price-precision.test.ts src/market-data/intraday/rows.property.test.ts src/market-data/streaming/replay.property.test.ts src/market-data/streaming/native-arrival.test.ts src/market-data/streaming/pricing-evidence.test.ts src/market-data/streaming/projection.test.ts src/intraday-replay/ledger.property.test.ts src/intraday-replay/broker.property.test.ts src/risk.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'property:' --timeout 150000
scripts.tsc: bun run tsc:all && bun run tsc:production
scripts.tsc:all: find ../../node_modules/.bun -path '*/@effect/tsgo-*/lib/tsc*' -type f ! -name '*.json' -exec chmod +x {} + 2>/dev/null || true; "$(bun node_modules/@effect/tsgo/dist/effect-tsgo.js get-exe-path)" --noEmit --project tsconfig.json
scripts.build:research: bun build src/jev-study-export-command.ts src/backtest-command.ts src/control-study-command.ts src/gap-recovery-command.ts src/ridge-training-command.ts src/hybrid-crash-vwap-shadow-command.ts tools/equity-edge-screen.ts tools/capital-study.ts tools/entry-timing-export.ts tools/matched-entry-study.ts tools/jev-signal-study.ts tools/jev-abstention-report.ts tools/verify-jev-plan.ts tools/native-arrival-coverage.ts --target=node --external tigerbeetle-node --external @platformatic/kafka --entry-naming '[name].js' --outdir=dist/research
